title: Gendernauts: A Journey Through Shifting Identities (KINO)

title_lang.en: Gendernauts: A Journey Through Shifting Identities (KINO)

synopsis:
San Francisco, at the turn of the millennium. Monika Treut turns her camera on a community of artists, scholars, and performers who live beyond the boundaries of conventional gender, blending technology, biochemistry, and sheer boldness to reshape their identities on their own terms.

 

Asked whether they are male or female, the gendernauts simply answer: yes.

 

Made at a time when transgender lives were rarely portrayed with dignity or nuance, Gendernauts remains a landmark of queer cinema, celebrating gender not as a fixed destination but as an open, joyful frontier.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
千禧前夕的舊金山，導演莫妮卡楚特跟隨一班藝術家、學者與表演者，走進傳統性別框架以外的世界。他們借助現代醫學科技與生化技術，憑自己意願重新定義性別及身份，活出獨一無二的自我。

 

當被問及「你是男是女？」，這群性別旅人的答案只有一個：是的。

 

在跨性別群體尚未獲得社會普遍尊重與關注的年代，《忽男忽女》以細膩溫柔的視角，記錄了這段珍貴的歷史時刻。性別，從來不是終點，而是一段無拘無束、充滿可能的旅程。
